name: Chine Hotel
accommodation: 79 en suite rooms, standard and superior, including family suites and interconnecting rooms
suitableFor: Families and couples wanting hotel facilities
beachAccess: Beach is a two-minute walk from the hotel grounds; near the Boscombe surf reef
confirmedFeatures: Swimming pool, Roman-style spa, Sea View restaurant, cocktail bar, three acres of grounds, children's playhouse, sea-view rooms with balconies
overview: A 79-room hotel on Boscombe Spa Road set in around three acres of grounds, a two-minute walk from the beach near the Boscombe reef. Many rooms have sea views and balconies, and there is a pool, spa, restaurant and bar on site.
surfTripFit: Two minutes from the sand near Boscombe Pier, with a pool and spa for days when the sea is flat.
